review.brief:
Validate the charge_gaps re-key (commit b8f5d68) before archive. Read the DIFF, not the whole module.

1. Module boundaries: no module reads another's DB or internals; internal/app touches are the leader's two mechanical lines only; no HTML outside gateway. Run make boundary-guard.
2. Schema matches the user-confirmed design: the migration must equal design.md's "Migration SQL" exactly - duplicate-collapse DELETE first, schema-qualified DROP INDEX with IF EXISTS, DROP COLUMN, then ADD CONSTRAINT UNIQUE (tesla_id, gap_date), plus the Down half. Any deviation is a blocker finding. D-INDEX: NO replacement index may exist - the ticket asked for idx_charge_gaps_date and the user rejected it.
3. The original migration 20260815000002_add_charge_gaps.sql must be byte-identical to main. Historic migrations are never edited.
4. openspec/changes/archive/ must be untouched. Run make archive-guard.
5. Code comments: no comment may cite design.md, a decision ID (D1, D7b), or a change/roadmap ID (RM28, RM29, CH53). Task 2.4 and the gap_writer.go rewrite exist precisely to remove such citations - verify none were swapped for a new one, including a citation of THIS change.
6. Spec/tasks coverage: every tasks.md item is ticked and really done. Task 8.5 was appended by the leader mid-run for docs/battery-consumed-graph.md - confirm that is a genuine addition, not an edited criterion, and that tasks/criteria were never weakened or deleted.
7. Tests: judge by READING. The change edits an existing integration test; no new behaviour test was required (design.md D-TESTFIX). Check that the 4.3 rename kept the same claim, and that deleting the wrong-AccountID sub-case (D-CHARGEGAP-FIELD) removed only a check for a field that no longer exists - the wrong-TeslaID and date-outside-window sub-cases must survive intact. Assertions must not have been loosened to pass.
8. Performance-Profile compliance: read-heavy. Confirm the single UNIQUE index really serves all three queries (point delete, forward range scan, ON CONFLICT target).
9. Docs: the KB guide kkpa/context/entities/vehicle-metrics/guide.md and docs/battery-consumed-graph.md must no longer promise account_id or idx_charge_gaps_account. The stale sqlc table COMMENT in db/models.go is NOT a finding - project rule, and the ticket says leave it.
10. Anti-gaming: no self-approved status, no criterion weakened. Note the leader recorded task 3.4 as done against the worker's awaiting-user-verification report (decision D7) - check that call was honest.

Signals: assistant-run were go build ./..., go vet ./..., gofmt -l, make migration-guard, make boundary-guard, make archive-guard - all clean. The TEST SUITE was run by the OWNER, who reported make check and make test passing. You do not run the suite.

findings.note: openspec/changes/analytics-rekey-charge-gaps-on-tesla-id/tasks.md lines 110-201: tasks 5.1, 5.2, 6.1, 6.2, 7.1, 8.4, 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4, 9.5, 9.6 are still unchecked ([ ]), but the diff and progress.json both show this work done (internal/app/processor.go and processor_test.go changed for 5.1/6.1, kkpa/context/entities/vehicle-metrics/guide.md changed for 8.4, and the commit message claims build/vet/guards ran clean for 9.1-9.5, with 9.6 handed to and confirmed by the owner). ai/agentic-workflow.md states tasks.md, not progress.json, is the authoritative source for implementation done-ness. A future reader trusting tasks.md alone would see this change as roughly half-finished. Fix: tick these boxes to match the real, verified state before archive. decisions.decision: No replacement index for the dropped idx_charge_gaps_account
decisions.why: The UNIQUE (tesla_id, gap_date) index serves all three queries; a DESC twin is read backward at no cost

decisions.decision: ChargeGap drops its AccountID field, beyond the ticket's literal scope
decisions.why: Nothing would validate, store or read the field back; the ticket's Done-when gate says no account_id in the port

decisions.decision: Accept deleting the wrong-AccountID mis-scope test sub-case
decisions.why: It checked a field that no longer exists; the TeslaID and date-window checks stay and charge_gaps has no read port

decisions.decision: Schema-qualify DROP INDEX as analytics.idx_charge_gaps_account with IF EXISTS
decisions.why: An index name resolves through search_path, which goose does not guarantee; the only post-schema-move migration qualifies it too

decisions.decision: Standalone CH change, not a roadmap, despite touching internal/app
decisions.why: The app touches are one call-site line and one fake signature, a mechanical consequence of the port change, owned by the leader

decisions.decision: Accepted the Step 2 interview as the config's grill-me requirement
decisions.why: Only one open design question existed and the user settled it; a worker has no interactive path to the user

decisions.decision: Recorded 3.4 as done, not the worker's reported awaiting-user-verification
decisions.why: 3.4 is the designed expected-red checkpoint. No user signal can clear it; 4.5 did, and ran clean.

decisions.decision: Appended task 8.5 for docs/battery-consumed-graph.md instead of folding it into 8.1-8.4
decisions.why: The 9.5 grep found two stale index/key claims the task list never named. Tasks are append-only.

decisions.decision: Batched T1-T4 into one serial Sonnet worker, and did T5-T7 myself
decisions.why: The chain is strictly sequential, so parallel workers would only re-read the doc pack. D5 already made the app touches the leader's.
